card.name: Words leading into 'the day'
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as in, the, of, throughout or through just before the word day (or school day, daily activities). It marks that a time span of a day is about to be named.

modes.label: Preposition before 'the day'
modes.description: A preposition or article right before 'day' in phrases like 'in the school day' or 'of the day'.
modes.example: pediatricians from the AAP support the importance of having a scheduled break<< in>> the school day.

modes.label: Throughout the day
modes.description: The word 'throughout' itself, followed by 'the day'.
modes.example: help us feel energized<< throughout>> the day, every day!

card.writes: It pushes the model toward 'throughout' and day-related words like all day and daytime.
card.plain: It fires on the little words that come just before 'the day', as in 'throughout the day'.
